examples.text: Un triage divise les grains d’orge en deux catégories qu’on malte séparément.

glosses: Mêler de malt, ajouter du malt.

examples.text: Mᵐᵉ Daragnès m'a apporté hier soir une boîte de café malté, un sac de chocolat en poudre.

glosses: Malted grain (sprouted grain) (usually barley), used in brewing and otherwise.

examples.text:
Oh many a peer of England brews
Livelier liquor than the Muse,
And malt does more than Milton can
To justify God's ways to man.

glosses: A milkshake with malted milk powder added for flavor.

examples.text: Afterward she sat in the drugstore sucking malt through a straw.

glosses: Maltose-rich sugar derived from malted grain.

To convert a cereal grain into malt by causing it to sprout (by soaking in water) and then halting germination (by drying with hot air) in order to develop enzymes that can break down starches and proteins in the grain.
graan verwerken tot mout; het laten ontkiemen van graan in water en het daaropvolgend doen drogen (eesten ww) om er mout van te maken
